messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning to add a per-tenant 'replay_capture' (temporary unmask/unredact) knob in Console. Need input on safe defaults: retention TTL, storage method (hash vs redact), and UX for requesting unmask. thinking: default off, admin opt-in, timeboxed tokens. Any strong objections?

ajay: Curious — is this limited to inspect-mode only or also available to account admins for heels-up debugging?

maria: inspect-mode + admin-triggered canary. plan is: tenant can request a short-lived replay token that temporarily shows a sampled request/response. token expires server-side.

nora: storage: prefer HMAC-with-rotating-key instead of storing raw PII. store the redacted payload + HMACs for fields we might want to correlate. keep raw only in breakglass replay cache which is TTL-limited.

tyler: +1 on HMAC. legal/regs aside, we also need clear audit trail for who unmasked and when. UI must show "who clicked" and exportable audit.

legal: for regulated customers (HIPAA, FINRA) hashed SSN/credit card is still considered sensitive in many jurisdictions. We need explicit opt-in and a data processing addendum for any tenant that enables replay_capture. Default must be off.

ops-oncall: operational ask: oncall needs a breakglass flow but it must be timeboxed and require 2FA + tag an incident number. also log TTL and destroy afterwards.

devex-bot: UI note — wording matters. propose: "Enable Replay Capture (restricted): temporarily view redacted requests for debugging. Admin approval required. All accesses are audited."

maria: draft config I'm thinking for the Console -> Tenant -> Debugging panel: 
```json
{
  "replay_capture": {
    "enabled": false,
    "default_sample_rate": 0.001,
    "store_method": "hmac", // options: "none", "hmac", "opaque-cache"
    "hmac_key_version": "k1",
    "raw_cache_ttl_seconds": 3600, // only used if "opaque-cache"
    "unmask_roles": ["org_admin","security_oncall"],
    "max_unmask_duration_seconds": 900,
    "audit_log_retention_days": 365
  }
}
```

ajay: couple of concerns: 1) default_sample_rate matters for quota — even sampled raw cache increases storage/telemetry budget; 2) how do we surface sample_count vs quota burn in the Console? need a headroom warning.

ntyler: we should show a per-tenant "replay budget" and realtime burn rate; when they cross 80% warn, 95% stop sampling. also expose a bulk deletion API for legal requests.

nora: technical: HMAC should be per-tenant salt + key rotation. use KMS to wrap keys, store only key_version id with records. For cross-region customers, keep keys regional. Also scrub attachments server-side with same policy.

legal: retention and deletion flow: must support immediate deletion on customer request (DSAR). record must be tombstoned and physical data wiped from caches within 24h. please document the flow.

ops-oncall: add a "review window" UI where an unmask session is started and auto-terminates — show countdown and require explicit checkbox "I certify this access is for debugging". store reason/incident id.

infra-bot: quick FYI — storing bigger sampled payloads will change our S3 lifecycle math. suggest adding a compression + dedupe step before persisting.

maria: next steps I propose: 1) update RFC with config snippet + KMS key rotation plan; 2) add Console UX mockups with audit and countdown; 3) legal sign-off for DPSA + DSAR flow; 4) telemetry metric: tenant.replay.sample_count and tenant.replay.quota_used. volunteers?

ajay: I can take telemetry metrics + quota stop rules.

nora: I'll do key rotation/KMS integration and the scrub libraries.

devex-bot: tagging: @product for UX copy, @security for policy review.

maria: thanks — will add to RFC and ping legal/product. :thumbsup:
